quote.text: In every walk with nature, one receives far more than he seeks.
quote.author: John Muir

fun_fact.text: Hungarian paprika isn't just one spice—there are eight different grades, ranging from delicate and sweet to bold and spicy! The town of Szeged and Kalocsa are famous for producing the world's finest paprika, which has been a cornerstone of Hungarian cooking for over 300 years.

short_read.title: The Secret Language of Trees
short_read.teaser: Scientists have discovered that trees communicate with each other through an underground network of fungi, sharing nutrients and even warning each other of danger. It's like a hidden internet beneath the forest floor!

medium_read.title: The Return of Sea Otters to the Pacific Northwest
medium_read.teaser: After nearly being hunted to extinction, sea otters are making a remarkable comeback along the Pacific coast. Their return is transforming coastal ecosystems in surprising and wonderful ways.

long_read.title: The Lost Art of Hungarian Embroidery
long_read.teaser: For centuries, Hungarian villages each developed their own distinctive embroidery patterns, creating a rich tapestry of regional folk art. Today, dedicated artisans are working to preserve these beautiful traditions for future generations.

port_angeles.title: Roosevelt Elk in the Valley
port_angeles.description: September is a wonderful time to spot Roosevelt elk in the Elwha Valley as they begin their fall mating season. These magnificent animals—the largest elk species in North America—were named after President Theodore Roosevelt and can often be seen grazing in meadows near Hurricane Ridge.

puzzle_1.question: A hummingbird's heart beats approximately ___ times per minute during flight.
puzzle_1.correct_response: Exactly right! That tiny heart is working incredibly hard to power those amazing wings!
puzzle_1.close_response: You're very close! The answer is 1,200 beats per minute—an astonishing pace!
puzzle_1.wrong_response: Those tiny hearts are amazing! A hummingbird's heart beats about 1,200 times per minute while flying.
puzzle_1.learn_more_text: To support this incredible heart rate, hummingbirds must visit hundreds of flowers each day to consume their weight in nectar. Their metabolism is so fast that they can starve to death in just a few hours without food!

puzzle_2.question: Which Hungarian word means 'butterfly'?
puzzle_2.correct_response: Wonderful! Pillangó is such a beautiful word for such a beautiful creature!
puzzle_2.wrong_response: The Hungarian word for butterfly is 'pillangó'—doesn't it sound lovely?
puzzle_2.learn_more_text: The word 'pillangó' comes from an old Hungarian word meaning 'to flutter.' Hungary is home to over 200 species of butterflies, including the stunning Swallowtail.

puzzle_3.question: What sea creature can regenerate its arms if they're lost to predators?
puzzle_3.correct_response: That's right! Starfish are amazing—they can even regenerate a whole new body from just one arm!
puzzle_3.wrong_response: It's the starfish! These remarkable creatures can regrow lost arms, and sometimes a whole new starfish can grow from a single severed arm.
puzzle_3.learn_more_text: The starfish you might see in tide pools along the Strait of Juan de Fuca include the beautiful purple and orange ochre sea stars. They play a vital role in keeping tide pool ecosystems balanced.
